config.design: Fresh-seed paired simulations; each generated dataset is reused across all six diagnostic rules. Compare in-sample, five-fold cross-fitted, and oracle overlap pass/warning rates. Hidden confounding remains zero.
config.monte_carlo_uncertainty: Bonferroni familywise 95% intervals across 48 profile-by-rule cells; threshold summaries provide six-rule familywise intervals with overlap/nuisance profile cells weighted equally.
config.interpretation: Exploratory synthetic operating study only. No threshold is selected or recommended; oracle propensities are diagnostic-only and unavailable in real observational data.
prohibited_changes: Do not tune or select a threshold from the previously inspected seeds.
Do not feed oracle assignment probabilities into AIPW or cross-fitted propensity models.
Do not treat this synthetic threshold grid as a production recommendation.

results.balanced_profile_summary_scope: Each threshold summary pools replicates while weighting the fixed overlap-by-nuisance cells equally.
results.oracle_usage: Diagnostic-only reference for false/missed warning rates; never an estimator input.
results.familywise_mc_interval_scope: Bonferroni familywise intervals across the fixed profile-by-threshold cells; Clopper-Pearson for warning rates and Student-t intervals for paired crossfit-minus-in-sample false-warning differences.
results.warning: Threshold performance is specific to the prespecified synthetic generator and rule grid. No threshold is selected or recommended for real observational data.

review_status: Self-review only; no independent peer review has occurred.
